description: This file defines a Java class 'UnAuthenticatedUserExceptionMapper' that implements an exception mapper for handling 'UnAuthenticatedUserException' exceptions in a web application. It maps such exceptions to HTTP 401 responses with a JSON error payload.

classes.name: UnAuthenticatedUserExceptionMapper
classes.description: A JAX-RS exception mapper that converts UnAuthenticatedUserException into HTTP 401 Unauthorized responses with a JSON payload.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Handles UnAuthenticatedUserException by logging and returning a 401 Unauthorized response with a standardized JSON error message.
